title: Destellito's Calendar Mod
description: Simple mod to answer the question 'What's the date today?' in our minecraft worlds, use /getdate to know!
body:
# What's this?
This is a very simple mod to answer the question **'What's the date today?'** in our minecraft worlds.

## How to use
To use this mod just simply execute the "/getdate" command!

## Works on old worlds or just on new ones?
Works in both!, **this mod uses minecraft in game day count**. For example, day 3 is 04/January/01 (minecraft daycount starts on 0). So yeah, it will setup by itself.
